title: recovery's run-unit proof drives superclaude with no far-box env
intention: recovery's run-unit proof drives superclaude under a scratch HOME with no far-box env, so its web tooth reads the same on a box whose session names another box as the cairn home.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_a_failed_unit_of_a_run_collects_itself reds 'web launched=False' because _drive copies os.environ, so CAIRN_HOME_HOST=akiendelllinux.local reaches superclaude, whose _sc_is_cairn_home (cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:14-20) then skips the web_server. With CAIRN_HOME_HOST and CAIRN_BUS_HOME unset the proof is green. A run also takes about 2 min, over the tester's 120 s default.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and CP6; d66f2e18fc5c's far-box-env shape.
how: Add _scratch_env(environ) returning environ minus TEST_ID_ENV, CAIRN_HOME_HOST and every key starting CAIRN_BUS_; _drive builds its env from _scratch_env(os.environ). A tooth hands _scratch_env an env naming a far box and asserts none of those names survive. Declare PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 600 at top level.
